[[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gameanim=yes |pv=no |envagame=[[Kira Buckland]] |javagame=[[Risa Shimizu]] }} '''Emilia Christie''' (Japanese: '''エミリア・クリスティー''' ''Emilia Christie'') is a reoccurring character in the game {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}}. She is a rookie assistant director at [[GNN]]. ==In the games== ==={{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}}=== {{incomplete|section|Missing info from chapters 5-8}} Emilia first appears in the [[vicinity of Tahnti Station]], where she tries to stop an {{p|Aipom}} from stealing a little girl's necklace. After the Aipom gets away, Emilia volunteers to stay with the little girl while [[Tim Goodman]] and {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|character}} retrieve the necklace. Later, she and her coworker [[Meiko Okamoto]] visit [[Litwick Cave]] to get footage for a story encouraging people to visit it, at their boss's suggestion. However, during filming, a wild {{p|Glalie}} suddenly goes berserk and starts attacking everything in the vicinity. Emilia injures her leg while trying to get away from it, but Tim and Pikachu show up in the nick of time and manage to drive Glalie away. Unfortunately, Glalie's attack caused the entrance of the cave to collapse, so they need to find another way out. Tim and Pikachu eventually find a wild {{p|Drifblim}} that carries Emilia and the others out of the cave. Emilia appears again in Chapter 3, being invited to [[PCL]] by [[Dorothy Fisher]] to prepare for shooting a special feature for a news program themed around "The Cutting Edge of Pokemon Research". She's pleasantly surprised to run into Tim. Emilia and Tim are feeding the laboratory's {{p|Trevenant}} prior to the shoot when suddenly, Trevenant goes berserk. Everyone gets out of the courtyard safely, but Trevenant does a lot of damage to the things in the courtyard. [[Wallace Carroll]] blames Tim for Trevenant's rampage and tries to fire him, but Emilia and Meiko stick up for him and say that Tim would never hurt a Pokémon. After watching through the footage that Meiko took, the PCL staff agree that Tim didn't do anything to provoke Trevenant. In Chapter 9, Emilia accompanies Tim and Detective Pikachu to the [[Baker Detective Agency]] so they can figure out where at the Pokémon Carnival [[R]] is going to be dispersed. After they determine that it will likely be at the [[Central Square]], Emilia heads there with the detective duo. While Tim and Pikachu investigate the area for possible locations of R, Emilia investigates her coworkers to see if any of them is acting suspiciously. She ends up being captured by her boss [[Roger Clifford]] and used as a hostage atop the clock tower in an attempt to stop Tim and Pikachu from shutting down the last R dispersing machine. She is helping us with our investigation of R-related incidents.'' |} ===Detective Pikachu Returns=== [[File:Detective Pikachu Returns Emilia.jpg|thumb|250px|Emilia in Detective Pikachu Returns]] Emilia cameos in Detective Pikachu Returns as the anchor for [[GNN]] News. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== Emilia is a considerate person and hates to inconvenience others. Emilia and Meiko do pretty much all their work together, from planning to filming. Occasionally, they have requests for content from their superiors, but generally they have the freedom to do what they want. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color}}|bordercolor={{electric color light}} |ja=清水理沙 [[Risa Shimizu]] |en=[[Kira Buckland]] }} ==Trivia== * Emilia appears to be the basis for the character [[Lucy Stevens]] in the movie adaptation, {{DetPikMov}}. * Emilia shares her last name with the mystery writer {{wp|Agatha Christie}}. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{yellow color}}|bordercolor={{red color light}} |ja=エミリア・クリスティー ''Emilia Christie'' |fr=Emilia Christie |de=Emilia Christie |it=Emilia Christie |es=Emilia Christie |zh_yue=艾蜜莉亞‧克利斯蒂 ''Ngaaihmahtleih'a Hāakleihsīdai'' |zh_cmn=艾蜜莉亞‧克利斯蒂 ''Àimìlìyǎ Kèlìsīdì'' {{tt|*|Traditional Chinese}}
